Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Bramm Coil. Character visual motifs: industrial tunnel-breaker with rotary ram-gun mounted to a back brace, orange work stripes and one reinforced leg.
TOP LEFT: Structural Survey. Ability concept: repeated hits on the same piece of deployable cover mark it as weakened (maximum one mark).
TOP RIGHT: Anchor Ram. Ability concept: shoots a riveted anchor 140 GU to a ground point. After 0.6 s the anchor pushes a rectangular 45Ã—90-GU blast **away from its own facing**; hits one time, moves enemies 24 GU, dislodges deployable barriers.
BOTTOM LEFT: Brace Exchange. Ability concept: Bramm exchanges mobility for steadiness for 3 s. He slows by 25%; each shot fired from the brace creates a short **safe opening** in allied cover that closes after 0.7 s, permitting planned fire without permanently destroying shields.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Tunnel Cut. Ability concept: slowly draws a huge visible straight cutting lane for 1.1 s. It then advances a mechanical ram through the lane over 1.4 s, collapsing temporary structures and forcing units sideways to the nearest free side; never passes world walls.
